gloss: original copy; official document; authenticated text

definitions.gloss: original copy; official document; authenticated text
definitions.explanation: The authoritative, official version of a document or text, as opposed to copies or drafts. Used in legal, administrative, and scholarly contexts for documents that carry legal or official weight.

examples.japanese: ⟦{契約書|けいやくしょ}→契約書：06416_keiyakusho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{正本|せいほん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保管|ほかん}する→保管する：25536_hokansuru⟧。
examples.english: To keep the original copy of the contract.

examples.japanese: ⟦{判決|はんけつ}→判決：05906_hanketsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{正本|せいほん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{裁判所|さいばんしょ}→裁判所：09665_saibansho⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{届|とど}いた→届く：00899_todoku⟧。
examples.english: The official copy of the verdict arrived from the court.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{文書|ぶんしょ}→文書：12947_bunsho⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦コピー→コピー：04883_kopii⟧⟦ではなく→ではなく：09578_dehanaku⟧{正本|せいほん}⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}して→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please confirm that this document is the original, not a copy.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{正|せい}→正：09511_sei⟧ (correct, authentic) and {本|ほん} (book, document). In legal contexts, the {正本|せいほん} is a certified copy issued by a court that has the same effect as the original. Distinct from an ordinary copy (⟦{写|うつ}し→写し：22466_utsushi⟧ or ⟦コピー→コピー：04883_kopii⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {正本|せいほん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{交付|こうふ}する→交付する：19899_koufusuru⟧: to issue an official copy
- {正本|せいほん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保管|ほかん}する→保管する：25536_hokansuru⟧: to store the original
- ⟦{判決|はんけつ}→判決：05906_hanketsu⟧{正本|せいほん}: certified copy of a judgment
- ⟦{契約|けいやく}→契約：02698_keiyaku⟧{正本|せいほん}: original contract document

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{原本|げんぽん}→原本：15697_genpon⟧: original — the very first version of a document from which copies are made
- {副本|ふくほん}: duplicate, secondary copy — an official copy made alongside the original
- ⟦{謄本|とうほん}→謄本：29796_touhon⟧: certified copy — a full copy of an official register, such as a family register (⟦{戸籍|こせき}{謄本|とうほん}→戸籍謄本：10286_kosekitouhon⟧)
